I now have a complete picture. Here is my report.

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic (REST) codebase where owner creation is an OfficeFloor function pipeline wired in `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`. The "owner identity" fields (`customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `checkDigit`, `locality`, `contactPreference`, etc.) are assigned by small single-purpose function classes under `.../rest/function/owner/`, backed by pure utilities under `.../util/`, stored on the `Owner` entity, and exposed via MapStruct + the OpenAPI-generated DTO.

Important: there is a redesign in flight. The current `customerCode` is `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`, but the acceptance test expects a new `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (SHA-256) format. Details in the last section.

---

## 1. customerCode — building and using it

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java` (whole file) builds it. Format `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`:
```java
19  public void service(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository ownerRepository) {
20      long sequence = Cities.countIn(ownerRepository, owner.getCity()) + 1;
21      owner.setCustomerCode(String.format("%s-%s-%04d",
22              prefix(owner.getCity()), prefix(owner.getLastName()), sequence));
23  }
25  private static String prefix(String value) {
26      return value.substring(0, Math.min(3, value.length())).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
27  }
```

Stored on the entity `Owner.java`: field `customer_code` (lines 62-63), getter/setter (135-141).
- DB column: `src/main/resources/db/h2/schema.sql:41` `customer_code VARCHAR(20)` (and the mysql/postgres/hsqldb schemas).
- Consumed downstream by: `AssignOwnerMembershipNumber` (input), `Owner.getCheckDigit()` (input to Luhn), and `AuditOwnerCreated` (logged).
- Exposed via OpenAPI at `src/main/resources/openapi.yml:2095-2100` (readOnly, example `PAR-FRA-0007`), mapped to the DTO automatically by MapStruct property-name matching (`mapper/OwnerMapper.java:23`).

The per-city sequence helper: `.../rest/function/owner/Cities.java:18-22`:
```java
static long countIn(OwnerRepository ownerRepository, String city) {
    return ownerRepository.findAll().stream()
            .filter(existing -> city.equals(existing.getCity()))
            .count();
}
```

---

## 2. Membership number + check digit

Membership number: `.../rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMembershipNumber.java` (whole file), format `<customerCode>-M<YY>`:
```java
15  public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
16      int yy = owner.getRegistrationDate().getYear() % 100;
17      owner.setMembershipNumber(String.format("%s-M%02d", owner.getCustomerCode(), yy));
18  }
```
Stored: `Owner.java` field `membership_number` (74-75), getter/setter (167-173); DB `schema.sql:45` `membership_number VARCHAR(30)`. OpenAPI `openapi.yml:2124-2129`.

Check digit (Luhn) is a derived, non-persisted property on the entity — `Owner.java:216-222`:
```java
public int getCheckDigit() {
    return LuhnCheckDigit.of(this.customerCode);
}
```
Algorithm: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/LuhnCheckDigit.java` (whole file). Static `of(String)` (21-40): walks right-to-left, doubles every second digit casting out nines, ignores non-digit chars (so it runs over the formatted `customerCode`), returns `(10 - (sum % 10)) % 10`. Exposed at `openapi.yml:2101-2108`.

---

## 3. Create audit record for owners

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java` (whole file):
```java
17  private static final Logger AUDIT = LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT");
19  public void service(@Val Owner owner) {
20      AUDIT.info("Owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
21              owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
22              owner.getMembershipLevel());
23  }
```
Runs after `SaveOwner` (so the id exists) and before `RespondWithOwnerCreated` — see the pipeline `owners.POST.yml:94-105` (`save -> audit -> respond`). It emits to a dedicated `AUDIT` SLF4J logger (no DB audit table). The test harness captures this logger via `src/test/java/.../acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java`.

---

## 4. Locality derivation

Derived property on the entity `Owner.java:188-197`:
```java
public String getLocality() {
    return CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity(this.postcode, this.city);
}
```
Logic: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CityLocality.java` (whole file):
- `CITY_REGION` table (16-17): Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD; anything else → `UNKNOWN` (20).
- `forCity(String)` (30-32): table lookup with `UNKNOWN` default.
- `forPostcodeOrCity(postcode, city)` (44-47): prefers `Postcodes.regionForPostcode`, falls back to `forCity`.

Exposed at `openapi.yml:2139-2144`. Note: the OpenAPI description there is stale — it says locality is derived "from the city via the fixed city-to-region table," but the code prefers the postcode-derived region first.

---

## 5. Sequence numbers in customerCode

The `<NNNN>` component is a per-city sequence: `AssignOwnerCustomerCode.java:20` computes `Cities.countIn(...) + 1` and zero-pads to 4 digits with `%04d` (line 21). The count is over all existing owners whose `city` matches exactly (`Cities.java:18-22`). It is not a DB sequence — it is recomputed from `ownerRepository.findAll()` at creation time. (Same city-count helper is reused by capacity rules like `EnsureCityUnderCapacity`.)

---

## 6. Region code derivation from postcode

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Postcodes.java` (whole file):
- `REGION_RANGE` (20-23): NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099.
- `hasValidFormat` (32-34): exactly four digits (`\d{4}`).
- `isAllowedForRegion(region, postcode)` (45-52): region with no range accepts any postcode.
- `regionForPostcode(postcode)` (62-74): reverse lookup — returns the region whose range contains the postcode, else `null`.

Used by `CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity` (region derivation) and by postcode validation: `.../rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerPostcode.java` — optional field; if present must be 4 digits and within the city's region range, else throws `InvalidPostcodeException` (400). Note it validates using `CityLocality.forCity(request.getCity())` (line 26), i.e. the city-table region, not the postcode-derived one.

---

## 7. Telephone normalization

Function: `.../rest/function/owner/NormalizeOwnerTelephone.java` — normalizes the request telephone to E.164 in place, throwing `InvalidTelephoneException` (400) when invalid (lines 17-21).

Core logic: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/E164PhoneNumber.java` (whole file):
- `DEFAULT_COUNTRY_CODE = "61"` (Australia) assumed when no leading `+` (line 20).
- `toE164(raw)` (44-61): strips spaces/dashes/brackets, keeps explicit `+CC`, else drops a single leading `0` and prepends `+61`; validates against `\+[0-9]{8,15}` (26).
- `hasValidNationalNumberLength(e164)` (72-82): checks national-number length per country (`NATIONAL_NUMBER_LENGTHS`: "1"→10 NANP, "61"→9 AU, lines 33-35). Used by `.../rest/function/owner/ValidateOwnerTelephoneLength.java`.

The normalized value is also stored (`Owner.telephone`, validated by the `@Pattern` E.164 regex on `Owner.java:50`) and forms part of `Owner.getIdentityKey()` (240-244) used for duplicate detection (`EnsureUniqueIdentityKey`). Pipeline order: `normalizeTelephone -> validateTelephoneLength` (`owners.POST.yml:19-25`).

---

## 8. Existing tests

All acceptance tests live under `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:

- `AcceptanceTest.java` — the only active checkpoint test. `coreCustomerCodeIsRegionHash()` (lines 10-15) creates an owner with a postcode and asserts:
```java

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters of the city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a hyphen, and a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'PAR-FRA-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an existing same-household owner is present; null otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'PAR-SMI-0007-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'PAR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3: starts at 1, plus 1 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the household id (or empty when none), joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the same last name and address (they share a household). Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: "The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), a hyphen, and the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: "A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and an existing same-household owner is present; null otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: "The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>': the customer code, '-M', and the last two digits of the registration date year (e.g. 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26')."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3: starts at 1, plus 1 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region derived from the city via the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The single value all duplicate detection is expressed through: the normalized telephone, the email (or empty when absent) and the household id (or empty when none), joined by '|'. Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
